extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Mutual of Omaha plan available in Orange County has a $10 monthly premium, a $5 drug deductible and a $4000 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan benefits before the disclaimer, which is compliant. The agent also collected the Scope of Appointment and scheduled a plan review, both of which were done in a timely manner.
composition.coaching_note: Grace did a good job by collecting the Scope of Appointment and scheduling the plan review. However, the agent could improve by ensuring the disclaimer is read first, even if the customer is only interested in costs. This would prevent any potential compliance issues.
